description: This file contains unit tests for the ConceptNumeric class within the OpenMRS project, verifying its behavior, equality, and persistence mechanisms.

classes.name: ConceptNumericTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ConceptNumeric class, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to leverage in-memory database and service context for testing.

methods.name: equals_shouldNotReturnTrueIfObjIsConcept
methods.description: Verifies that a ConceptNumeric object does not equal a Concept object and vice versa.

methods.name: equals_shouldNotBeTheSameReference
methods.description: Checks that various lists within Concept and ConceptNumeric are distinct objects.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptAnswerReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Ensures that answers added to a Concept are correctly referenced back to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptSetReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Checks that ConceptSet objects are properly linked to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptNameReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Verifies that ConceptName objects reference the correct parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptDescriptionReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Checks that ConceptDescription objects are linked to the parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldChangeConceptMapReferenceToParentConcept
methods.description: Ensures ConceptMap objects are associated with the correct parent ConceptNumeric.

methods.name: shouldSaveAConceptNumericWithAllowDecimalValue
methods.description: Verifies that a ConceptNumeric's allowDecimal property is correctly saved and retrieved from the database.

methods.name: shouldRemoveReferenceRangeFromConceptNumeric
methods.description: Tests the removal of a ConceptReferenceRange from a ConceptNumeric object and persistence.

methods.name: shouldMaintainInsertionOrderOfReferenceRangesWithConstructor
methods.description: Ensures that the order of ReferenceRange objects added to ConceptNumeric is maintained.
